title: Sage vocabularies
description: The open vocabularies (issue #28) and the entries plugins registered: AI conditions, quest objectives, dialogue conditions and actions, ability deliveries, effect executions, item uses. Generated by `sage schema`.

ability_delivery:id.description: An ability_delivery by id: area, projectile, self, touch, touch_area.

ability_delivery.description: An ability_delivery: its id, or { "kind": "<id>", … } with its settings.

action:id.description: An action by id: apply_effect, change_standing, finish_quest, give_item, set_stage, start_quest, take_item.

action.description: An action: its id, or { "action": "<id>", … } with its settings.

ai_condition:id.description: An ai_condition by id: CanCastAtEnemy, CanMelee, Casting, EnemyInMeleeRange, LostEnemy, NoEnemy, RememberEnemy, ScheduleDone, SeeEnemy, SpellComingBack, TaskFailed.

ai_condition.description: An ai_condition: its id, or { "kind": "<id>", … } with its settings.

ai_schedule_selector:id.description: An ai_schedule_selector by id: default, rules.

ai_schedule_selector.description: An ai_schedule_selector: its id, or { "kind": "<id>", … } with its settings.

condition:id.description: A condition by id: has_item, has_tag, lacks_tag, quest, standing.

condition.description: A condition: its id, or { "condition": "<id>", … } with its settings.

effect_execution:id.description: An effect_execution by id: dispel, knockback, summon, teleport.

effect_execution.description: An effect_execution: its id, or { "execution": "<id>", … } with its settings.

effects.description: Effects to remove. Names a effect record. (List<RecordRef<EffectRecord>>)

effects+.description: Adds to "effects": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

effects-.description: Removes these from "effects" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

tags.description: Remove every effect that grants one of these tags. Names a tag record. (List<RecordRef<TagRecord>>)

tags+.description: Adds to "tags": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

tags-.description: Removes these from "tags" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

force.description: How hard it pushes across the ground. Unit: m/s. (float, default 6)

lift.description: How hard it pushes up. Unit: m/s. (float, default 2)

distance.description: How far in front of the target. Unit: m. At least 0. (float, default 1.5)

prefab.description: What appears. Names a prefab record. (RecordRef<PrefabRecord>)

offset.description: Where to, as right, up and forward of the one it is measured from. Unit: m. (Vector3, default [0,0,5])

toSource.description: Measure from the source (a pull) rather than the target (a blink) (bool, default false)

item_use:id.description: An item_use by id: cast, consume, read.

item_use.description: An item_use: its id, or { "use": "<id>", … } with its settings.

ability.description: The ability it casts. Names a ability record. (RecordRef<AbilityRecord>)

effects.description: Effects applied to whoever uses it up. Names a effect record. (List<RecordRef<EffectRecord>>)

effects+.description: Adds to "effects": what a base or an earlier definition listed, then these.

effects-.description: Removes these from "effects" (as a base or an earlier definition listed it).

teach.description: An ability reading it teaches. Names a ability record. (RecordRef<AbilityRecord>)

quest_objective:id.description: A quest_objective by id: have, kill, reach, talk.

quest_objective.description: A quest_objective: its id, or { "kind": "<id>", … } with its settings (no "kind" means kill).

count.description: How many it takes. At least 1. (int, default 1)

item.description: The item to carry. Names a item record. (RecordRef<ItemRecord>)

text.description: What the journal calls it; empty = built from its fields. (string, default "")

count.description: How many it takes. At least 1. (int, default 1)

faction.description: Whose members count. Names a faction record. (RecordRef<FactionRecord>)

prefab.description: Or which prefab's entities count. Names a prefab record. (RecordRef<PrefabRecord>)
